speaker: Daniel
text: Exploring the moon has inspired scientists and engineers, fascinated young and old, and motivated young people to pursue scientific careers, not only in space but also in the depths of the ocean or in the nucleus of an atom. Reaching the moon, the first outpost in deep space, is just the beginning of our space odyssey.
